text: Austrian **bus stop signs** contain a yellow and green circle with the letter **H**.
NOTE: This design is relatively unique in Europe. The only other country with similar bus stop signs is Germany.
text_zh: 奧地利的**公車站牌**包含一個黃綠相間的圓圈，中間帶有字母 **H**。
註：這種設計在歐洲相當獨特。唯一擁有類似公車站牌的國家是德國。

text: Bus stops consisting of **neon-yellow poles** are found in Vorarlberg.
text_zh: 由**螢光黃色桿子**組成的公車站牌可在福拉爾貝格邦找到。

text: Bus stop signs in Denmark are **black and yellow**. A small sign is attached to the top of the pole, with the bus schedule underneath. Additionally, you may see this older [**blue and white**](https://goo.gl/maps/fRjTDJetFmcvkqtt6)** **version.
text_zh: 丹麥的公車站牌是**黑黃相間**的。桿子頂端附有一個小牌子，下方則是公車時刻表。此外，你可能會看到這個較舊的[**藍白**](https://goo.gl/maps/fRjTDJetFmcvkqtt6)** **版本。

text: Most departments have their own unique logo (formally called official flag), often containing stylized initials or the entire name. Notable infrastructure with department logos include [bus stops](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1CqFWtzhUqLV2k8n7), [kilometre markers](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JGY1Xwa8SvPyyV5A9), [trail banners](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kP4kjMrH3rK5gLSZ7), [directional signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QM5gqNqrRtf4gWRR6) and [signbacks](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZHA8UMQL6eFzSNyP6). Learning what each logo looks like is not recommended for beginners, but it can be helpful to know what they stand for when scanning.

You can find the full list of logos [here](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flags_of_the_regions_of_France#French_Departments), or see them projected onto a map [here](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/06/Flag_Map_of_Departments_of_France_Version_2_%28Logo_Flags%29.png).
text_zh: 大多數省份都有自己獨特的標誌（正式稱為官方旗幟），通常包含風格化的縮寫或全名。帶有省份標誌的知名基礎設施包括[公車站](https://maps.app.goo.gl/1CqFWtzhUqLV2k8n7)、[公里標石](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JGY1Xwa8SvPyyV5A9)、[步道標示](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kP4kjMrH3rK5gLSZ7)、[方向標誌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QM5gqNqrRtf4gWRR6)和[標誌背面](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ZHA8UMQL6eFzSNyP6)。不建議初學者學習每個標誌長什麼樣子，但在掃描時了解它們代表什麼會很有幫助。

你可以在[這裡](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flags_of_the_regions_of_France#French_Departments)找到標誌的完整列表，或在[這裡](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/06/Flag_Map_of_Departments_of_France_Version_2_%28Logo_Flags%29.png)查看它們在地圖上的投影。

text: Moreover, all bus stops are protected by **concrete bollards** with unique black-and-yellow **warning bands**.
NOTE: Similar, but not quite identical designs are found in some Malaysian cities.
text_zh: 此外，所有公車亭都受到**混凝土路樁**的保護，並配有獨特的黑黃相間**警告條紋**。
注意：在某些馬來西亞城市也能找到相似但不完全相同的設計。

text: In addition to the concrete bollards on bus stops, Singapore sometimes has a unique and yellow **bus-leaving box** with an **arrow** on the street.
text_zh: 除了公車站的混凝土路樁之外，新加坡街頭有時也會出現一個獨特的黃色**公車離站方框**，裡面帶有一個**箭頭**。

text: Each state has a **unique **bus stop design. These are quite common in urban rounds, so are worth learning. Darwin bus stops are usually [concrete shelters](https://goo.gl/maps/UR1Qq4BcyJGkCZ9n8).
NOTE: The designs may vary slightly, but should still be recognisable. There are multiple versions of Tasmanian bus stops, but most of them should have the word ‘metro’ on it.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 每個州都有**獨特**的公車站設計。這些在城市回合中很常見，值得學習。達爾文的公車站通常是[水泥候車亭](https://goo.gl/maps/UR1Qq4BcyJGkCZ9n8)。
注意：設計可能略有不同，但仍應能辨識。塔斯馬尼亞的公車站有多種版本，但大多數都應該有「metro」這個詞。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: **Yellow signposts** are specific to Western Australia.
NOTE: Although South Australia does not use yellow signposts for regular road signs, SA bus stops will have yellow posts.
text_zh: **黃色標誌桿**是西澳州特有的。
備註：雖然南澳州的一般道路標誌不使用黃色標誌桿，但南澳州的公車站牌會使用黃色桿子。

text: Bus stops are always marked by **yellow signposts**. Bus shelters often have **yellow roofs**.
text_zh: 公車站總是標有**黃色站牌柱**。公車亭通常有**黃色屋頂**。

text: Bus stop signs in Flanders (and Brussels) have a **white rectangle** at the top. In Wallonia they will have a [**yellow top**](https://goo.gl/maps/RXMysmC593bvR99HA).
text_zh: 法蘭德斯（以及布魯塞爾）的公車站牌頂端有一個**白色長方形**。瓦隆尼亞的公車站牌則有[**黃色頂端**](https://goo.gl/maps/RXMysmC593bvR99HA)。

text: In addition, these regions each have their own **bus stop sign**.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 此外，這些地區各自擁有專屬的**公車站牌**。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: The **bus stops** on the island of Bornholm have this unique green, red and white colour scheme.
text_zh: 博恩holm島上的**公車站**採用這種獨特的綠、紅、白配色方案。

text: Estonian bus stop signs have this design.
The bus has **four windows**. This is mostly useful to distinguish it from the Latvian bus stop sign, which has five windows.
Note, however, that Lithuania has the same bus stop signs as Estonia.
text_zh: 愛沙尼亞的公車站牌採用這種設計。
公車有**四扇窗戶**。這主要有助於將其與擁有五扇窗戶的拉脫維亞公車站牌區分開來。
不過請注意，立陶宛使用與愛沙尼亞相同的公車站牌。

text: **Concrete bus shelters** are a common sight on roads in Eswatini.
text_zh: **混凝土公車站亭**是史瓦帝尼道路上的常見景象。

text: Finland has two styles of **bus stop signs**, a blue and white one, and a yellow and black one.

NOTE: This can be used to tell Finland apart from Sweden, which has many different bus stop signs ([example](https://goo.gl/maps/h4BWBzQgVu4mtNgr6)), most of which have the names of the stops on them.
text_zh: 芬蘭有兩種風格的**公車站牌**，一種是藍白相間的，另一種是黃黑相間的。
註記：這可用於區分芬蘭和瑞典，瑞典有許多不同的公車站牌（[範例](https://goo.gl/maps/h4BWBzQgVu4mtNgr6)），其中大多數都標有站名。

text: Bus stops on Åland include a **white plate** with 4 numbers. Some also include this semicircle sign on top.
NOTE: Some bus stops in Mariehamn do not follow this rule.
text_zh: 奧蘭的公車站包括一個帶有 4 個數字的**白色牌子**。有些也在頂部包含這個半圓形標誌。
註記：瑪麗港的一些公車站不遵循這項規則。

text: Like Austria, Germany uses a wide variety of regional bus stops, all of which have the big **yellow** and **green** **H** symbol on them.
text_zh: 如同奧地利，德國使用各種不同的區域性公車站，這些站牌上都有大型的**黃色**與**綠色** **H** 符號。

text: Every city state uses a unique and recognisable bus stop.
- Berlin uses **segmented** bus stops, with a **yellow** signpost.
- Hamburg bus stops have a **red signpost**, and the route numbers are within **hexagons**. Note that they can be found outside of Hamburg as well.
- Bremen proper uses simple bus stops, which have the bus stop name within a **red section**. The edges can be rounded.
- Bremerhaven, which is still part of Bremen, uses bus stops with a **grey section** on the opposite side of the signpost. And the bus stop name is **red** within a **yellow** section.
text_zh: 每個城市邦都使用獨特且易於辨識的公車站。
- 柏林使用**分段式**公車站，配有**黃色**標誌柱。
- 漢堡公車站有一個**紅色標誌柱**，路線編號位於**六邊形**內。請注意，它們也可以在漢堡以外地區找到。
- 不萊梅本市使用簡單的公車站，其公車站名稱位於**紅色區段**內。邊緣可以是圓角。
布勒梅港（Bremerhaven）仍屬於布萊梅的一部分，其公車站牌的背面有一個**灰色區塊**。公車站名則顯示在**黃色**區塊內的**紅色**字體。

text: These are the most useful to learn bus stops.
- Atyrau has a **modern design**, with white and** lime/neon green** walls. The bus stop name is prominently written on top.
- Kostanay uses **simple brown bus stops**, that have a **blue and yellow crest** on one of the glass panes.
- Petropavl also has brown bus stops, with glass panes on all 3 sides not facing the road. The **roof is angled slightly upwards**.
- Karaganda uses old looking **turquoise** bus stops, which have a **curved roof**.
Zhezqazghan has **very wide blue bus stops**, which have **2 sections**; 1 indoors, and one outside. These sections are separated by a door.
text_zh: 這些是學習公車站牌最實用的部分。
- 阿特勞有一個**現代設計**的公車站，牆面為白色與**萊姆綠／霓虹綠**。公車站名稱顯眼地寫在頂部。
- 庫斯塔奈使用**簡單的棕色公車站**，其中一塊玻璃上有個**藍黃相間的徽章**。
- 彼得羅巴夫爾也有棕色公車站，背對馬路的 3 個側邊都有玻璃窗。**屋頂稍微向上傾斜**。
- 卡拉干達使用的是看起來很舊的**土耳其藍**公車站，帶有**弧形屋頂**。
傑茲卡茲甘有**非常寬敞的藍色公車站**，分為 **2 個部分**：1 個在室內，1 個在室外。這兩個部分由一扇門隔開。

text: These cities have buses worth learning.
- Aktobe uses **orange and black** buses.
- Zhezqazghan has **orange and white **buses, with “Men ♥ Jezz/Zhez” written on the sides.
- Astana commonly uses these **white**, **black**, and **green **electric buses.
- Karaganda uses** turquoise** buses, just like their bus stops.
- Semey has these **light green** and **white **buses.
- Almaty uses fully green buses, with white patterns and the city name on the sides. Taraz can use similar buses, but they will have “Taraz” written on the sides instead.
text_zh: 這些城市的公車值得學習。
- 阿克托貝使用**橘色與黑色**的公車。
- 傑茲卡茲甘有**橘色與白色**的公車，車身上寫著「Men ♥ Jezz/Zhez」。
- 阿斯塔納常見這種**白色**、**黑色**與**綠色**的電動公車。
- 卡拉干達使用**土耳其藍**的公車，就像他們的公車站一樣。
- 塞梅有這種**淺綠色**與**白色**的公車。
- 阿爾馬提使用全綠色的公車，車身有白色圖案和城市名稱。他拉茲也會使用類似的公車，但車身上的字樣會改成「Taraz」。

text: Latvian bus stop signs have this design.
Most importantly, the bus has **five windows**. Within the Baltics, this is unique to Latvia. The other two Baltic countries have four windows.
text_zh: 拉脫維亞公車站牌採用這種設計。
最重要的是，公車有**五扇窗戶**。在波羅的海國家中，這是拉脫維亞獨有的。其他兩個波羅的海國家有四扇窗戶。

text: Bus stops in Liechtenstein use a **green-and-white** design, with a black metallic border around the sign. The phrase LIEMOBIL is written at the top.
NOTE: The metallic frame is not always black.
text_zh: 列支敦斯登的公車站採用**綠白相間**的設計，標誌周圍有一圈黑色金屬邊框。頂部寫著 LIEMOBIL 字樣。
注意：金屬框不一定都是黑色的。

text: Unlike the rest of Liechtenstein, Vaduz sometimes uses **red bus stop signs.**
NOTE: ** **Regular bus stops are also present.
text_zh: 與列支敦斯登其他地區不同，瓦都茲（Vaduz）有時會使用**紅色的公車站牌。**
注意：** **一般公車站也看得到。

text: Unlike the rest of Liechtenstein, Balzers sometimes uses **black bus stop signs.**
NOTE: ** **Regular bus stops are also present.
text_zh: 與列支敦斯登其他地區不同，巴爾澤斯（Balzers）有時會使用**黑色的公車站牌。**
注意：** **一般公車站也看得到。

text: Lithuanian bus stop signs have this design.
The bus has **four windows**. This is mostly useful to distinguish it from the Latvian bus stop sign, which has five windows.
Note however, that Estonia has the same bus stop signs as Lithuania.
text_zh: 立陶宛的公車站牌採用這種設計。
公車有**四扇窗戶**。這主要有助於將其與擁有五扇窗戶的拉脫維亞公車站牌區分開來。
不過要注意的是，愛沙尼亞的公車站牌跟立陶宛的一樣。

text: **Bus stop signs** are blue and always have this exact design. The bus has six windows.
NOTE: Bus stop signs in Belgium and the Netherlands have significantly different designs. For example, the Belgian bus stop sign always has a [yellow signpost](https://goo.gl/maps/HRqx4mPFRvtkV2u2A).
text_zh: **公車站標誌**是藍色的，並且總是這種確切的設計。公車有六扇窗戶。
注意：比利時和荷蘭的公車站標誌設計有明顯的不同。例如，比利時的公車站標誌總是配有[黃色標誌柱](https://goo.gl/maps/HRqx4mPFRvtkV2u2A)。

text: Bus stops signs on Madeira follow a unique **black, white **and** yellow** colour scheme.
text_zh: 馬德拉島的公車站牌採用獨特的**黑色、白色**與**黃色**配色方案。

text: **Bus stops** are a common sight in Malta. They may sometimes have useful information as to where you are.
text_zh: **公車站**在馬爾他是常見的景象。它們有時可能包含關於你所在位置有用資訊。

text: The cities of Auckland, Wellington and Christchurch all have unique bus stop signs.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 奧克蘭、威靈頓和基督城的公車站牌都各有特色。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Norwegian bus stops usually have this small, **blue sign** with a white bus.
NOTE: Sweden has a lot of different bus stops, none of which look like this.
text_zh: 挪威的公車站通常有這個帶有白色公車的小型**藍色標誌**。
注意：瑞典有許多不同的公車站，但沒有一個長這樣。

text: There are six distinct bus stop designs on Réunion:

- [Yellow](https://goo.gl/maps/q9CtkypqeALhBfrC7) - This is the most common type and can be found all over the island. It is usually accompanied by another bus stop, meaning you can get a good region guess if you see it on its own.

- [L Shaped](https://goo.gl/maps/Yts9EDaePYnjKk1L8) - It can either be white, or an [olive](https://goo.gl/maps/jgR9cBEvaMmKFu8SA) colour. It may also be in the form of a [bus shelter](https://goo.gl/maps/ERRyoQBRSTDCwNPL6). It is almost never accompanied by a yellow bus stop.
- [Pink](https://goo.gl/maps/psuwbrTTAkRmBatTA) - Rarely accompanied by a yellow bus stop.
- [Orange](https://goo.gl/maps/iab3u7VkEDbP1hSb6) - Almost always accompanied by a yellow bus stop.
- [Green](https://goo.gl/maps/kg61UkiurFFoe8hX6) - Almost always accompanied by a yellow bus stop.
- [Red](https://goo.gl/maps/tL9qM1Uzg6ThwBay7) - Rarely accompanied by a yellow bus stop.
This infographic shows where each one can be found. The list above is ranked by how common each one is found.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 留尼旺有六種截然不同的公車站牌設計：
- [黃色](https://goo.gl/maps/q9CtkypqeALhBfrC7) - 這是最常見的類型，全島各地都找得到。它通常會伴隨另一個公車站牌出現，這意味著如果你單獨看到它，就能很好地猜出區域。
- [L 形](https://goo.gl/maps/Yts9EDaePYnjKk1L8) - 可以是白色，或是[橄欖綠](https://goo.gl/maps/jgR9cBEvaMmKFu8SA)。它也可能以[候車亭](https://goo.gl/maps/ERRyoQBRSTDCwNPL6)的形式出現。幾乎從不與黃色公車站牌同時出現。
- [粉紅色](https://goo.gl/maps/psuwbrTTAkRmBatTA) - 很少與黃色公車站牌同時出現。
- [橘色](https://goo.gl/maps/iab3u7VkEDbP1hSb6) - 幾乎總是與黃色公車站牌同時出現。
- [綠色](https://goo.gl/maps/kg61UkiurFFoe8hX6) - 幾乎總是與黃色公車站牌同時出現。
- [紅色](https://goo.gl/maps/tL9qM1Uzg6ThwBay7) - 很少與黃色公車站牌同時出現。
這張資訊圖表顯示了每種站牌的所在位置。上面的列表是依據各站牌的常見程度由高到低排列。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: These are the bus stops unique to specific federal subjects in Russia. Notably common and memorable ones include Krasnoyarsk Krai, Chuvashia, Tatarstan, and Mari El Republic.
text_zh: 這些是俄羅斯特定聯邦主體特有的公車亭。其中特別常見且令人印象深刻的有克拉斯諾亞爾斯克邊疆區、楚瓦什共和國、韃靼斯坦共和國與馬里埃爾共和國。

text: Most bus stops in Asturias have a red post with the CTA logo at the top.
NOTE: These may be confused with [Madrid bus stops](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BUtYyixugRSHYbgR8), which can also have a red post. The company in charge of Madrid public transport goes by EMT.
text_zh: 阿斯圖里亞斯的許多公車站都有一個紅色的柱子，頂端帶有 CTA 標誌。
注意：這些可能會與[馬德里公車站](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BUtYyixugRSHYbgR8)混淆，後者也可能有紅色的柱子。負責馬德里大眾運輸的公司名稱為 EMT。

text: The surrounding region of Madrid has round topped **red bus stops**, and **green buses**. Some bus stops are just a [red post](https://goo.gl/maps/gtNJEs9Bswb7QT9PA).
In the city centre, you can find urban blue buses.
text_zh: 馬德里周邊地區有頂端呈圓形的**紅色公車站**以及**綠色公車**。有些公車站只是一根[紅色的柱子](https://goo.gl/maps/gtNJEs9Bswb7QT9PA)。
在市中心，你可以找到藍色的市區公車。

text: Each administrative region in Sweden has at least one, and in many cases several, bus stop signs which are unique to that region.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 瑞典的每個行政區都至少有一個、通常是好幾個該地區特有的公車站牌。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Many regions have their own distinct type of bus shelters, which may either replace or complement the bus stop signs. This image contains the ones which are most common and easily recognizable.
NOTE: Every region has multiple types of bus shelters, these are simply the most common.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 許多地區都有其獨特的候車亭類型，可能會取代或搭配公車站牌。這張圖片包含最常見且易於辨識的候車亭。
注意：每個地區都有多種類型的候車亭，這些只是最常見的。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: Many cities and towns have their own **local bus stop signs**, which are different from the signs in the rest of the region (as shown in the infographic in section 2).
NOTE: The Växjö sign can also occasionally be found in [Älmhult](https://www.google.se/maps/@56.5567675,14.149378,3a,15y,299.09h,91.08t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s2Sf4lzoXR-D-KsTijUw3yA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192).
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 許多城市和小鎮都有各自的**當地公車站牌**，這與該地區其他地方的標誌不同（如第2節中的資訊圖表所示）。
注意：韋克舍（Växjö）的標誌偶爾也可以在[埃姆霍爾特（Älmhult）](https://www.google.se/maps/@56.5567675,14.149378,3a,15y,299.09h,91.08t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s2Sf4lzoXR-D-KsTijUw3yA!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)找到。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: **Neon-yellow** school bus stop signs are commonly found in the municipalities of Linköping, Norrköping and Jönköping.
text_zh: **霓虹黃色**的學校公車站牌常見於林雪平（Linköping）、北雪平（Norrköping）和延雪平（Jönköping）自治市。

text: If you see Västra Götaland bus stops combined with **three blue stripes** as shown in the picture, you are in Kungsbacka municipality.
NOTE: These same stripes are found on bus stops in all of Halland.
text_zh: 如果你看到西約特蘭（Västra Götaland）公車站牌結合了如圖所示的**三道藍色條紋**，你就位於孔斯巴卡（Kungsbacka）自治市。
注意：哈蘭（Halland）所有公車站牌上都能找到這些相同的條紋。

text: Black bus shelters with this specific design, mainly recognised by the square ridge along the back of the roof, can be found in Västerås and Umeå.
text_zh: 這種具有特定設計的黑色公車候車亭，主要特徵是屋頂背面的方形山脊，可以在韋斯特罗斯（Västerås）和于默奧（Umeå）找到。

text: These bus stop signs, with thick **metal signposts** going around them, are unique to Switzerland.
text_zh: 這些公車候車亭站牌周圍繞著粗大的**金屬支柱**，是瑞士特有的景象。

text: Bus stop shelters with a vibrant **yellow-and-green** paint scheme, featuring sunflowers and the name of a local brand (Оліс), can be found in the Mykolaiv and Kherson oblasts.
text_zh: 在尼古拉耶夫州和赫爾松州可以找到塗裝充滿活力、带有向日葵及當地品牌名稱 (Оліс) 的**黃綠相間**公車候車亭。

intro.lead: 站牌與候車亭的造型由地方交通單位統一
body: 看候車亭的骨架材質、頂棚形狀與站牌的版面設計。因為是統一發包，同一地區的樣式高度一致，辨識度比想像中高。
站牌上的路線資訊也常帶有地名與語言線索，值得放大看。
